acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retained as a necessary byte-level noninterference gate. It is insufficient until a newly hash-bound proposal formally enumerates the omitted visibility classes and registers coverage for opaque agenda identifiers, selectable record types, complete row-manifest invariance, and canonical side-channel normalization.

Retained as a necessary state-machine fixture. It cannot be authored uniquely until automatic DREAM scheduling, normalized operation fingerprints, branch tie-breaking, failure debits, and the lifecycle transition table are frozen in repaired proposal bytes.

Retained for restricted action-deletion labels and provenance algebra. A repaired proposal must additionally bind domain-canonical root construction and complete independent-life reset behavior; this test cannot establish causal usefulness of outcome-associated cognition.

Retained for deterministic artifact construction, mounting, row isolation, and resource accounting. It cannot establish behavioral transport or recurrence, and repaired bytes must add reader-only LoRA isolation, exact active-versus-total byte rules, the resolved treatment inventory, and any required contrast combinations.

Retained as a necessary independent-construction gate. It remains insufficient until paired-world byte relations, intentionally treatment-specific bytes, CompilerGym near-duplicate criteria, independent implementation provenance, and canonical shuffle and cut transformations are frozen.

Retained as an executability and construct-sensitivity gate on development fixtures. It cannot demonstrate a sealed treatment effect, and PATH_ONE_SHOT does not implement the advertised removal of recurrent THINK computation. Its model-execution authority must also be made non-circular.

Retained for prospective manifest completeness and planned-contrast identifiability. It does not by itself establish power, model fit, error control, or statistical validity, and repaired bytes must register quantitative adequacy, repeated-cycle mediation, sham controls, and the exact capacity definition.

Retained as a mandatory independent veto over exact implementation, proportionality, authority, and constructibility. It cannot establish an unexecuted scientific result or replace missing registered tests, and its canary/model authority must be repaired before it can legally pass.

Retained as the final recomputation, lifecycle, and claim-suppression gate. A postrun audit cannot repair missing interventions, underidentified contrasts, unauthorized execution, opened-target reuse, or an incomplete prospective test registry.

agreements: The proposal preserves the project thesis that one recurrent base-plus-life-LoRA controller emits public cognition and action, DREAM provisionally reconciles causally available conscious state, and SLEEP alone writes durable per-life parametric memory.

Current-item public transitions may support recurrent replanning only inside the same item; prior-item results, target scores, hidden truth, oracle state, and target-derived repair signals remain quarantined from later cognition and writing.

Action deletion can label necessity only for the exact declared open-loop action trace. It does not validate cognitive truth, generalized causal explanations, or the usefulness of preceding public operations.

Synthetic descendants, paraphrases, DREAM restatements, diamonds, and repeated exposure must not create independent evidence; support must be counted through domain-canonical root-equivalence classes.
Stage B common-source comparisons can identify treatment assignment, transport, structure, and action effects, but cannot establish online lifetime learning or the complete mediated flywheel.

Fixed-corpus transport, operation-policy adaptation, recurrent computation, authentic structure, action imitation, and downstream value are distinct estimands; no artifact-construction golden or aggregate score may substitute for their executed contrasts.
Cross-substrate comparisons require common inference constraints plus explicit substrate-specific construction, storage, indexing, training, cache, candidate-work, latency, and lifecycle accounting.

Independent sealing requires independently authored selection logic as well as matching outputs; shared byte identity alone cannot establish independence, twin validity, split novelty, or shortcut resistance.

Stage C must prospectively bind independent lives as sampling units, reset all life-local state, distinguish new acquisition, old retention, and cross-era composition, and keep target-panel results reporting-only.

PCFL-Stream can support capacity, retention, storage-efficiency, and continuing-acquisition results, but learned higher-order compression requires the prospective PCFL-Schema intervention described by the bound design note.
Pre-GPU fixtures and review establish prospective executability, authority, and design adequacy only. Scientific effects require the later authorized execution and postrun audit.

Parenting remains outside current scope, ENDPOINT receives authority only from the local proposal, and no consensus recommendation can authorize implementation, model calls, training, GPU work, or claims without the required human and technical gates.

The critique identifies missing acceptance tests not present in the proposal registry. Consensus cannot invent those IDs, so the current chain requires a repaired proposal with a new hash-bound test registry.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. The six grouped information items do not define the exact domain required by the promised Cartesian closure.
concern_dispositions.required_change: In a newly hash-bound proposal, separately classify target goal/current state, target membership/order, writer support status, retrieval scores and candidate enumeration, oracle and ceiling artifacts, caches, batching, errors, generator metadata, and other observable side channels at every stage; register explicit byte-noninterference and audit tests.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Removing free text does not prevent semantic information from being encoded in identifiers, record types, ordering, or manifest inclusion.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind opaque harness-generated identifier grammars, an exact selectable-record predicate, deterministic target- and condition-invariant DREAM slicing, and complete selected-row-manifest invariance under answer, future-target, score, and condition swaps; register the missing dedicated tests.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. The inherited automatic DREAM trigger, repeat identity, failure charging, and BACKTRACK selection can produce incompatible experiments.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Freeze whether automatic pressure DREAM exists and, if retained, its exact threshold and transition; also freeze the normalized operation fingerprint, every failure debit, deterministic BACKTRACK tie rule, and all legal next states before authoring fixtures.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. The proposal relies on a control absent from its v2 treatment and acceptance-test inventories.
concern_dispositions.required_change: A repaired proposal must either register COGNITIVE_NO_ACT as a mandatory v2 treatment with construction and executed-gate coverage, or remove every attribution and claim that relies on it. The current registry contains no test that can close this choice.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Set algebra cannot produce reproducible support counts until raw domain events are canonically assigned to roots.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Specify canonical CompilerGym replay/transition and PCFL chronological/twin root-equivalence rules, including repeated observations, confirmations, regenerated events, and task boundaries, and register fixtures with determinate expected root sets.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Supported composite shortcuts and PATH ACT targets can supply the decisive structure or action without later local-edge construction.
concern_dispositions.required_change: For any local experiential composition claim, exclude complete composite shortcuts and target-sufficient action mappings from PATH, place them in separately labeled controls, or exclude affected targets from composition credit; require item-level proof that no single return or stored policy target is sufficient.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. PATH_ONE_SHOT removes adaptive retrieval and FOLLOW but retains recurrent THINK and same-item action/outcome recurrence.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Either add and register a treatment that actually removes recurrent THINK computation while preserving the relevant information and budgets, or rename the existing contrast as adaptive-retrieval removal and withdraw every recurrent-computation claim based on it.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking for factorial or component-main-effect language. PATH differs from each single-family arm on multiple dimensions, and ENDPOINT is not a matched ACT-only arm.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Either register the missing contrast combinations, including the combinations needed for READ, DECIDE, ACT, and intended interactions, or publish an explicit estimand matrix limited to the literal component-ladder contrasts and remove unsupported main-effect and interaction claims.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. A q/v LoRA mounted globally can change THINK logits even if trained only on READ rows.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Freeze a reader-only adapter boundary or separate reader process, unmount the adapter before thinker computation, and require identical returned bytes, thinker weights, prompts, and candidate domains after each read; register dedicated isolation fixtures.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking for unrestricted superiority claims. The enumerated controls support narrower comparisons, while STANDARD and TARGET_STATE_ONLY are not byte-distinguished.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Byte-specify STANDARD and TARGET_STATE_ONLY interfaces. Then either add prospectively specified reflection/lesson memory, direct trajectory-to-QA LoRA, and same-lifetime batch post-training controls, or explicitly limit every conclusion to the enumerated v2 baselines.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. Capacity matching and promotion remain target-sensitive unless serialization, overhead, cache, and controlling resource-view rules are frozen.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Define active and total bytes, LoRA precision and serialization, optimizer/checkpoint treatment, payload/index/metadata/manifest/cache/alignment accounting, deterministic retained-byte matching, and the prospective resource view controlling each promotion and claim.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Agreement between sealers does not define the scientific equality relation across paired worlds or the novelty relation across CompilerGym splits.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Freeze the exact pre-memory bytes and side channels that twins must share, the treatment-specific bytes that may differ, candidate-domain equality, CompilerGym family and near-duplicate criteria, and independent-sealer provenance checks.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Uncontrolled corruption can masquerade as authentic-structure sensitivity.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Specify deterministic shuffle and cut algorithms that preserve registered marginals and load, reject cycles, detect accidental surviving decisive paths, identify the decisive bridge or binding mechanically, and bind the expected counterfactual action.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. The qualitative chain does not determine cadence, estimands, matched removals, or the evidence threshold for a repeatedly closing flywheel.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Freeze the observation-to-DREAM-to-SLEEP-to-publication-to-remount-to-evaluation cadence; distinguish wrong-memory, same-state, and memory-cut estimands; add sham removal matching row count and exposure; and preregister the number of independent episodes and successive completed cycles required.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. Prospective completeness prevents many goalpost changes but cannot validate variance transfer, power, model fit, or error control.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Narrow T07's interpretation to prospective completeness and design identifiability, and add a newly registered quantitative adequacy gate covering development-to-evaluation variance transfer, independent-root power, model assumptions, multiplicity, and co-primary error control.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking for learned-compression claims. PCFL-Stream identifies accumulating knowledge and fixed-capacity behavior, not discovery of a higher-order lossy schema.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Either restrict current claims to capacity, retention, storage efficiency, and fixed-substrate response surfaces, or add the separately prospective PCFL-Schema rung with pre-confirmation prediction and schema-specific twins, shuffles, substrate controls, and cuts.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. Root-level inference is invalid if any learned, declarative, temporary, or cached state crosses independent lives.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a cold reset invariant for adapters, accepted-row manifests, external stores, workspaces, ledgers, reader and model caches, RNG/process state, and all other condition-local state at every independent life root; audit it before and after each root.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. T06 and the inherited canary appear to require model execution that current scope forbids, while the later run manifest depends on T08 already passing.
concern_dispositions.required_change: A repaired chain must either define genuinely no-model T04/T06/T08 preflight semantics or obtain a separate exact human ratification for a bounded non-science canary before those tests; no test may infer authority from its own required output.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Deferring legal transitions lets CPU fixtures choose scientific behavior that the architecture did not ratify.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Place the exact lifecycle transition, charge, status, resume, publication, mount, missing-cell, integrity-stop, and forbidden-suffix table in newly hash-bound architecture bytes before implementing T02 or T04 fixtures.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. Construction, development-fixture execution, manifest completeness, and review cannot establish behavioral effects or scientific closure.
concern_dispositions.required_change: In a repaired proposal, narrow T04 to construction and isolation, T06 to executability and falsifier sensitivity, T07 to prospective completeness and design identifiability, and T08 to authority, constructibility, proportionality, and pre-run adequacy; reserve effects for authorized execution and T09.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. Claim suppression alone does not prevent revealed evaluation targets from becoming development data in a nominal follow-up.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind every failed sealed gate as a registered negative result. Any later writer, metric, threshold, treatment, interface, or target redesign must use a new change ID, fresh unopened targets and seals, new interpretations and critique, new consensus, and new human ratification.

disagreements.issue: Whether grouped visibility classes and typed DREAM payload fields are sufficient, or whether every privileged datum, identifier, selection decision, and observable side channel must receive an exact stage-level classification and noninterference rule.

positions.position: Retain the six-item matrix and typed REQUEST_DREAM payload, relying on prose denylists, byte scans, and postrun audit to cover omitted subtypes and identifiers.

Enumerate every materially distinct information class, use opaque harness identifiers and exact selectable-record predicates, and test both serialized inputs and complete row-manifest selection under counterfactual swaps.

resolution.rationale: Grouped prose cannot establish the promised exact Cartesian boundary, and semantic identifiers or selection membership can carry forbidden information without copying free text.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the complete-byte-contract position in a new proposal and register the missing dedicated visibility, opaque-identifier, and manifest-selection tests; the cited existing tests cover only part of the concern.

disagreements.issue: Whether DREAM scheduling, repeat identity, failure charges, branch choice, and lifecycle transitions may be delegated to later declarations or must be ratified before CPU fixtures encode them.

positions.position: Treat thresholds, debit tables, tie rules, and the detailed lifecycle table as implementation or run-manifest details covered by broad state-machine and review tests.
Freeze these rules in the architecture chain before implementation because they change prefixes, opportunities, statuses, resume behavior, and scientific identity.

resolution.rationale: Independent fixtures cannot have unique expected results while the automatic trigger, repeat fingerprint, debit table, branch tie rule, and lifecycle transitions remain open.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the architecture-bytes position and add the exact operation and lifecycle tables plus newly registered adversarial tests in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether COGNITIVE_NO_ACT is a mandatory inherited control or whether v2 supersedes it and must remove every attribution that depends on it.

positions.position: Treat COGNITIVE_NO_ACT as inherited from v1 and add it explicitly to the v2 treatment and test inventories.
Treat the v2 condition list as exhaustive, omit COGNITIVE_NO_ACT, and remove scientific attribution that cites the absent control.

resolution.rationale: Both choices can be coherent, but they produce different treatment inventories and attribution boundaries. The current bytes simultaneously rely on and omit the arm.
resolution.required_change: A new proposal must choose one position explicitly and register the resulting inventory. No existing test ID fully covers this missing compatibility test.

disagreements.issue: Whether generic root-set union plus the phrase per-life is sufficient, or whether domain-canonical root construction and a complete cold-reset boundary are normative requirements.

positions.position: Let implementations map raw events to roots and reset ordinary per-life objects consistently with the high-level algebra.
Freeze domain-specific root equivalence and explicitly reset every learned, declarative, temporary, cached, process, and manifest state at each independent life root.

resolution.rationale: Support counts and inferential independence are undefined without canonical raw-event grouping and complete cross-root isolation.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the domain-canonical position and register dedicated root-mapping and cross-life reset fixtures in the repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether PATH, PATH_ONE_SHOT, direct-record closure, and cuts identify recurrent composition from local experiential atoms, or only adaptive retrieval within a corpus that may contain shortcuts and direct action targets.

positions.position: Treat PATH over PATH_ONE_SHOT plus shuffle and cut sensitivity as sufficient for recurrent local-pathway construction.
Exclude or separately treat composite shortcuts and target-sufficient ACT mappings, add a true recurrent-THINK removal treatment, and reserve PATH_ONE_SHOT for adaptive-retrieval attribution.
Keep the current treatments but withdraw recurrent-computation and local-atom composition claims, reporting only adaptive retrieval and literal treatment effects.

resolution.rationale: The current contrast does not remove recurrent THINK computation, and inherited shortcuts can bypass local-edge construction. Adding the missing treatments and narrowing the claim are materially different scientific designs.
resolution.required_change: A repaired proposal must choose between the true-recurrence position and the narrow-claim position. It must also register the missing recurrence-removal and shortcut-exclusion coverage if the stronger claim is retained.

disagreements.issue: Whether READ_LORA, DECIDE_LORA, PATH, ENDPOINT, and the fixed-corpus assay identify a READ/DECIDE/ACT factorial and isolated transport, or only a component ladder with globally coupled adapter effects.

positions.position: Treat the existing three trained arms and fixed-corpus assay as sufficient for transport, policy, action, and interaction attribution.
Add the missing READ/DECIDE/ACT combinations and a reader-only LoRA boundary so intended main effects, interactions, and transport are mechanically isolated.
Keep the current arms but describe only their literal coupled contrasts and remove factorial, separate-policy, ACT-main-effect, and isolated-transport claims not actually identified.

resolution.rationale: The existing ladder cannot estimate the advertised component effects, and globally mounted q/v weights can change thinker computation. Completing the design or narrowing the claims leads to different architecture and compute.
resolution.required_change: A new proposal must choose the complete-contrast or literal-contrast position. Isolated transport additionally requires a reader-only mount boundary and a newly registered isolation test.

disagreements.issue: Whether the enumerated baselines justify strong-agent-memory or general LoRA-superiority language, and whether STANDARD and TARGET_STATE_ONLY are sufficiently specified.

positions.position: Call the best enumerated v2 treatment the strongest baseline and retain broad superiority language.
Add reflection/lesson memory, direct trajectory-to-QA LoRA, and same-lifetime batch post-training, while byte-specifying every baseline interface.
Keep the enumerated set, byte-specify STANDARD and TARGET_STATE_ONLY, and restrict conclusions to those named treatments without general superiority language.

resolution.rationale: The current controls are meaningful but selective relative to the bound thesis note. Expanding the benchmark and narrowing the claim are both coherent but materially different choices.
resolution.required_change: A repaired proposal must choose the expanded-baseline or claim-restriction position and must byte-specify STANDARD versus TARGET_STATE_ONLY under either choice.

disagreements.issue: Whether conceptual cost categories and two reported views suffice, or whether exact byte accounting and one prospective claim-specific promotion view must be frozen.

positions.position: Report equal-inference and full-cost views and decide which is most informative after observing results.
Freeze active/total accounting, serialization and overhead rules, capacity matching, and the controlling view for each promotion and claim before results open.

resolution.rationale: Post-result choice of the favorable resource view would make LoRA-specific promotion target-sensitive and irreproducible.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the prospective-resource-rule position and register exact byte-accounting and promotion-rule coverage in the repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether independent seal agreement and high-level shuffle/cut descriptions establish twin indistinguishability, split novelty, and authentic-connection causality.

positions.position: Allow independent implementations to instantiate paired-world equality, near-duplicate exclusion, shuffles, and decisive cuts from the prose requirements.
Freeze exact equality and novelty relations plus deterministic marginal-preserving transformations, survival rejection, and counterfactual-action expectations.

resolution.rationale: Independent implementations can agree on the same underspecified interpretation, while generic corruption can create a false connection effect.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the canonical-transformation position and register the missing twin-relation, near-duplicate, shuffle-survival, decisive-cut, and sealer-provenance tests.

disagreements.issue: Whether a qualitative mediation chain plus prospective manifest is sufficient for a full flywheel, or whether exact cadence, sham interventions, independent episodes, and successive-cycle criteria are required.

positions.position: Permit the full-flywheel claim when one registered episode exhibits the three directional links and the longitudinal curve is favorable.
Freeze event cadence and distinct estimands, use sham-matched removals, and require a preregistered number of independently rooted episodes and successive completed cycles.

resolution.rationale: One episode or unmatched removal cannot establish a repeatedly closing action-observation-sleep-memory-value flywheel.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the repeated-identification position and register the missing mediation-cadence, sham-removal, and repeated-cycle test in the repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether complete manifests, development fixtures, and reviewer approval can falsify statistical validity or scientific closure before execution.

positions.position: Treat T04, T06, T07, and T08 as capable of establishing behavioral attribution, statistical validity, and scientific closure before the sealed run.
Limit them to construction, executability, prospective completeness, identifiability, authority, proportionality, and quantitative design adequacy; reserve scientific effects for execution and audit.

resolution.rationale: Preflight can prevent underidentified or unauthorized work but cannot make an unexecuted effect true. Manifest completeness also does not prove power or model fit.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the bounded-preflight position, repair the falsifier language, and register a separate quantitative power and adequacy gate in the next proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether fixed-capacity PCFL-Stream response surfaces warrant learned-compression language or whether that language requires the prospective PCFL-Schema rung.

positions.position: Call preserved or improving value at fixed adapter bytes compression when the minimal sufficient statistic grows.
Describe PCFL-Stream only in terms of capacity, retention, storage efficiency, and fixed-substrate response surfaces.
Retain learned-compression language only after adding the prospective PCFL-Schema prediction, control, transport, twin, shuffle, and cut interventions.

resolution.rationale: The bound stream note explicitly separates accumulation under fixed capacity from discovery of a lossy higher-order schema. Restricting the claim and adding the schema rung imply materially different scope.
resolution.required_change: A repaired proposal must choose the capacity-only or schema-extension position. The present test registry has no schema-specific acceptance test.

disagreements.issue: How T04, T06, and T08 can legally pass when current scope forbids model calls and training but the inherited canary and executed baselines may require them.

positions.position: Define T04, T06, and the T08 canary as deterministic no-model contract, simulation, and artifact checks; defer all actual model and adapter execution to a later ratified manifest.
Obtain a separate exact human ratification for a bounded non-science model/train/reload canary before completing T06 and T08.
Treat architecture ratification as implicitly authorizing the canary and development execution despite A12's explicit prohibition.

resolution.rationale: The implicit-canary position violates the explicit authority boundary. The two lawful alternatives differ materially in what evidence preflight can produce and require human selection.
resolution.required_change: A newly hash-bound chain must choose either genuinely no-model preflight semantics or a separate bounded canary ratification and then remove the circular dependency. No current test can confer its own authority.

disagreements.issue: Whether postrun claim suppression and a no-repair rule are sufficient, or whether every redesign after opening sealed results must start a fresh target and ratification chain.

positions.position: Permit revised writers, thresholds, metrics, or treatments to reuse opened targets when described as diagnosis rather than retry.
Preserve the original result as negative and require a new change ID, fresh unopened targets and seals, complete deliberation, and new ratification for every scientific redesign.

resolution.rationale: Renaming target-informed tuning as diagnosis would defeat the no-repair and target-quarantine contracts.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the fresh-chain position and register an explicit negative-result and fresh-target versioning gate in the repaired proposal.

questions: Do you direct preparation of a newly hash-bound PPC v2 successor that incorporates every accepted repair and registers the critique's missing tests, without treating this rework consensus as ratification?
Should the repaired treatment inventory include COGNITIVE_NO_ACT, or should every attribution relying on that control be removed?
Should the stronger pathway claim add true recurrent-THINK removal and explicit local-atom/shortcut separation, or should claims be limited to adaptive retrieval and the current literal contrasts?
Should component attribution use a sufficient READ/DECIDE/ACT contrast matrix with reader-only LoRA isolation, or should the current component ladder retain only narrow coupled-treatment claims?
Should the benchmark add reflection/lesson memory, direct-QA LoRA, and batch post-training, or explicitly restrict comparisons to the enumerated baseline set?
Should Stage C remain a PCFL-Stream capacity and retention study, or add a separately prospective PCFL-Schema rung before using learned-compression language?
Should preflight be entirely no-model, or should a separate exact human-ratified non-science canary scope precede T06 and T08?

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Artifact reconstruction can establish construction, isolation, mounting, and accounting, not behavioral transport, recurrence value, or pathway causality.
Accepted. T07 can establish prospective completeness and planned-contrast identifiability, while adequacy and validity require quantitative preflight and later execution.
Accepted. The current set supports named-treatment comparisons but cannot support unrestricted strong-memory superiority without added controls or narrower claims.
Accepted. Independent review remains a mandatory veto over authority and design adequacy but cannot establish an unexecuted scientific effect.
Accepted. The formal matrix must enumerate or bind every materially distinct information class rather than relying on grouped prose.
Accepted. The registered arms form a component ladder; a full factorial claim requires missing combinations, otherwise attribution must be restricted to literal contrasts.
Accepted. The proposal must add the omitted baseline classes or limit its superiority claims to the enumerated controls.
Accepted. Local-edge composition credit requires explicit exclusion, separate treatment, or item-level disqualification of target-sufficient shortcuts.
